chunk_text: Each bhava signifies more than what is stated above, and in that case the significator can also be different. For example, for the 9th house, Jupiter is the karaka for fortunes, but the Sun is the karaka for father. For the 12th house, Saturn is the general significator, but Ketu is the indicator for final emancipation (moksha).
